rows.out: Hm. Courier, is it. I've no parcels needing sending, and the forge is hot. Speak quick, friend.
Hm. Smoke's smoke. Forge breathes it same as always, and I don't talk while the iron's hot.

out: Did you finish the king's new sword?
Could I buy a good blade from you?
I'll leave you to your work, Mira.
Où est passée l'épée du roi, Mira ?
Je voudrais acheter une lame, s'il vous plaît.
Je vous laisse. Bonne forge, Mira.

out.text: Hm. Smoke's smoke, same as always. Forge breathes it whether I will or no.
Smoke, smoke! That's not just smoke, that's a whole chimney's worth of worry, worry.
Measure twice. I've kept this fire lit longer than you've kept sourdough rising, friend.
Then let it cool a while, a while. Even ovens rest, and so should you, you.

rows.out: No. I don't curse at folk I've just met, and I don't curse at all with the iron in the fire. Measure twice.
Ana. Courier. You told me twice already, and I've a memory for folk who watch my shop from the street.

Mira.last_words: No. I don't curse at folk I've just met, and I don't curse at all with the iron in the fire. Measure twice.
